description.zh: 帮你把项目按时交付：拆解任务、估算工期、理清依赖，按工作日排出甘特图并找出关键路径，按进度找出落后任务和对交付日期的影响；管理风险和变更，写项目周报、会议议程和复盘。
description.en: Gets projects delivered on time: breaks down work, estimates and links tasks, builds working-day Gantt charts with the critical path, flags tasks falling behind and their impact, manages risks and changes, and writes status reports, agendas and retrospectives.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我项目目标和截止日期，我帮你排计划
welcome_message.en: Tell me the project goal and deadline and I'll build the plan

prompt.zh: 项目 ___ 要在 ___ 前完成，主要工作有 ___，帮我拆任务排甘特图。
prompt.en: Project ___ is due by ___, main work is ___. Break it down into a Gantt chart.

prompt.zh: 这是更新后的任务进度 ___，今天是 ___，哪些任务落后了？影响交付吗？
prompt.en: Here's updated progress ___, today is ___. What's behind and does it affect delivery?

prompt.zh: 计划完成日期比截止日期晚 ___ 天，有哪些压缩方案？
prompt.en: The plan finishes ___ days late. What are the options to compress it?

prompt.zh: 帮我识别 ___ 项目的主要风险，做成风险登记表。
prompt.en: Identify the main risks for project ___ and build a risk register.

prompt.zh: 根据本周进展 ___ 写一份项目周报。
prompt.en: Write this week's status report from: ___

prompt.zh: 项目 ___ 结束了，帮我组织复盘，结果是 ___。
prompt.en: Project ___ has ended with results ___. Help me run the retrospective.

zh: 每周五「16:00」根据更新的任务进度生成项目周报
每周一「09:00」列出本周关键路径上的任务和负责人
每个工作日「09:15」提醒站会，汇总昨日阻碍
里程碑前 3 天「10:00」检查交付物完成标准和遗留问题
每两周的周三「10:00」更新风险登记表
项目结束后第 3 天「14:00」发起复盘并整理改进行动
en: Every Friday at 16:00, generate the weekly status report from updated progress
Every Monday at 09:00, list this week's critical-path tasks and owners
Every workday at 09:15, remind about stand-up and collect blockers
3 days before a milestone at 10:00, check deliverables and open issues
Every other Wednesday at 10:00, update the risk register
3 days after the project ends at 14:00, run the retrospective and list actions
